painPoints.body1: We hear these 6 problems almost word for word in every first call. Sometimes all 6 at once.
painPoints.body2: None of them need to exist in 2026. The solutions are already there, just not in your company yet.
painPoints.futureText: Office jobs are not disappearing. But the part everyone complains about?
painPoints.roiLink: What is this costing you per year? Calculate ROI

time.title: of working time disappears into tasks nobody would miss
time.description: Your employees type in numbers that have been digital for years. They copy data from Excel into SAP. They write reports manually that could run automatically. While competitors automate, you are burning potential.

cost.title: That is 200,000€ thrown out the window. Every year.
cost.description: With just 10 employees, you are burning over 200,000€ per year on tasks with no real value. That is the annual salary of 3 qualified specialists. Every year. Simply gone. For work that could have been automated long ago.

quality.title: Every mistake costs money. And your reputation.
quality.description: Manual data entry always produces errors. Customers complain. Invoices are wrong. Delivery dates get missed. And while your team fixes mistakes, the actual work piles up. Frustrating? Absolutely. Avoidable? Yes.

knowledge.title: When Petra retires, 30 years of expertise walk out the door
knowledge.description: Only she knows how that one process works. Only she knows all the edge cases. And when she leaves? Chaos. Errors. Delays. New colleagues need months to catch up, if you can find anyone at all.
knowledge.statLabel: of IT leaders report knowledge loss

chaos.title: 86% type invoices as if the internet never happened
chaos.description: A PDF arrives by email. Your employees open it, read the numbers, type them into the ERP. Errors included. OCR software has existed for 20 years. Yet 86% of SMEs work like it is 1995. Absurd? Yes. Fixable? Immediately.

competition.title: 81% know: without AI we will fall behind
competition.description: Your competitors are already using AI. Your industry is changing. Faster, more efficient, cheaper. Without you. While you are still deciding whether AI is relevant, others are pulling ahead. The gap grows. Every day.
competition.statLabel: see AI as the most important future technology

waiting.title: While you are still planning, your competitor has already automated
waiting.subtitle: AI adoption in German companies doubled in the last year. Not in 10 years. In 12 months. Whoever waits now will not close this gap. The question is not IF but WHEN you start.

From the basics to advanced prompt techniques for immediate results. Includes concrete use cases from the engineering day-to-day.

schulungen.title: Workshop: Automation and AI automation
schulungen.description: Hands-on workshop for process owners and teams. What is automation? How do classic workflows differ from AI-driven automation? Participants learn to spot automation potential and apply AI deliberately, from simple workflows to intelligent multi-agent systems.

beratung.title: AI tool audit for a mechanical engineering firm: uncover shadow AI and cut costs
beratung.description: Systematic audit of all AI tools in the company. Which tools are employees using (ChatGPT, Copilot, others)? GDPR risks identified, licence costs analysed, tool sprawl stopped. Consolidated to 3 approved enterprise solutions with central management.

beratung.title: Tool selection workshop: the right AI platform for an online retailer

beratung.result: Decision made in 2 days instead of 3 months, 40% cost savings

items.question: What does AI consulting cost for an SME?
items.answer: The initial consultation is free. After that it depends on scope. An AI Readiness Check takes 2 days; a longer engagement can span several months. In the first conversation we work out together what is realistic for your company, no hidden line items.

items.question: How quickly does an SME see results from AI automation?
items.answer: With training: often during the workshop itself. Many participants use the tools productively for the first time that same day. With automation projects: 2 to 6 weeks to a working prototype, depending on complexity. We have had email automation ready in one week.

items.question: Does an SME need its own IT department for AI projects?
items.answer: No. Most of our clients do not have a dedicated IT department. We guide you from idea to finished solution, technically and in terms of content. The solutions we build, your people can operate themselves, without an IT degree.

items.question: Does AI automation work with existing systems like SAP or Microsoft 365?
items.answer: Usually yes. We work with what you already have in place. Our solutions connect to Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, SAP, industry-specific software, and other systems. In an AI Audit we analyse your existing system landscape and find integration points without complex migration.

items.question: How do we measure the ROI of an AI investment?
items.answer: Before every project we agree together on what can be measured and how: hours saved, fewer errors, shorter cycle times. We take a baseline measurement and compare after delivery. Our ROI calculator shows the potential upfront, no registration required.

items.question: What is the difference between AI automation and an AI agent?
items.answer: Classic automation follows fixed rules: if A happens, then B. Valuable, but rigid. An AI agent can make independent judgements, gather information, and take decisions without every step being programmed in advance. A concrete example: no human assigns a research task, the agent recognises what is currently important, and delivers a structured report every morning. That is the difference.

items.question: Are AI solutions GDPR-compliant and safe from a data protection perspective?
items.answer: We build data protection in from the start. Where possible, we work with European providers and on-premise solutions. Sensitive company data only leaves your network with explicit approval. In regulated industries we deliberately choose data-protection-compliant alternatives to US services.
